title: Monopoly Go 推出 Avengers: Doomsday 赛季，为 Scopely 第三次 Marvel 联动
content:
Monopoly Go gets an Avengers: Doomsday season in Scopely’s third Marvel crossover – Mobilegamer.biz
Skip to content
Scopely is bringing Marvel back to Monopoly Go for a new season themed around Avengers: Doomsday.
The game’s third Marvel tie-in, Doomsday Go, runs from November 25 to January 27 and follows the
September 2024
crossover and a
Fantastic Four event
last July. It kicks off three weeks before Avengers: Doomsday opens in UK cinemas on December 16, two days ahead of the US.
Doomsday Go players will work their way around new boards set in Doomstadt, Doctor Doom’s castle in Latveria, and the X-Mansion, and face Doom himself in a Coin Flip battle. The season’s sticker album has 23 sets, with characters including Thor, Iron Man, Deadpool, Wolverine and Spider-Man.
Scopely is also adding animated Shields, Tokens and Dice, plus rarer Super Stickers that each unlock a permanent Super Token cosmetic. A new Super Hero Smash ability in the Treasures minigame clears between 25% and 100% of the remaining tiles, depending on how charged it is, and there are new Super Hero Coins, each with what Scopely calls “a unique twist” that leads to rewards.
“For our third Marvel integration in Monopoly Go, we pushed the game’s animation and visual effects further than ever before while creating new ways for Tycoons to play, collect, and express their fandom,” said Victor Diaz-Roig, president of games at Scopely.
The latest collab follows on from crossovers with recent crossovers with
Kpop Demon Hunters
and
The Simpsons
, among others.
